switcheroo.n: Only works on bosses. Automatically accepts a random item and removes currently held item.

teatime.n: Only affects Boss pokemon. They immediately use any held berries.

matcha-gotcha.n: Pokemon heals 50% of the damage taken by the target. 10% burn chance.

me-first.n: Can not gain additional projectiles. Can only be used on bosses. If the boss is readying an attack, the pokemon copies that attack, casts immediately at 1.5x power. Only casts if the Pokemon's Speed > Boss Speed.

plasma-fists.n: Changes Normal type moves this pokemon has to be electric type for 2s.

population-bomb.n: At each step in the Chain, hits randomly between 1 and 10 times before moving to next pokemon on chain.

power-split.n: Can only target bosses. Cannot gain additional projectiles. Averages Attack and Special Attack with the target.

power-swap.n: This may need a new kind, that pauses the game and lets the caster pick an enemy on screen to swap with. Long Cooldown. Will pause MP, but MP deferred.

guard-split.n: Can only target bosses. Cannot gain additional Projectiles. Averages Defense and Special Defense with the target.

hidden-power.n: Uses a special calculation we can import.

horn-drill.n: Accuracy is not in game. Instead we will use causes OHKO on enemy that are 2+ levels below.

sketch.n:
Can only be affected by Boss moves. 

The next move to hit this pokemon replaces this move. (remove this move, add the move that hit this pokemon in its slot.)

skill-swap.n: Does what it says, though really only useful in Gym Leader boss battles or Elite Four. Kind as Projectile that cannot gain additional projectiles.

sky-drop.n: All cooldowns paused for 2s on cast. Then both Target and Player's pokemon gain Immunity to all damage for 2s. Then damage is dealt to pokemon. Sky Drop's cooldown does not start until both 2s steps have completed.

snatch.n: If an enemy casts a buff on self, it instead applies to player's pokemon.

snore.n: Only works if the user is sleeping.

spotlight.n: Randomly selects a pokemon in a cone. All enemies within 5x that pokemon's sprite radius attack it as if it was a player.

ruination.n: Cooldown override: 30s. Randomly selects one enemy in Aura radius and halves its current HP.

salt-cure.n: Inflicts unique DoT. 1 stack max. deals half the damage of Burn stack. Deals double the damage of Burn stack on Steel or Water types. Deals 4x on Steel/Water dual types.

nature-power.n:
Terrain	Name	Type	Cat.	Power	Acc.
Buildings, paved/plain terrain or wi-fi/linked battles	Tri Attack	Normal	Special	80	100
Grass, flowers, woods or with Grassy Terrain in effect	Energy Ball	Grass	Special	80	100
Sand, rocky terrain or Pokémon Dens	Earth Power	Ground	Special	90	100
Caves	Power Gem	Rock	Special	70	100
Water	Hydro Pump	Water	Special	120	80
Snow or icy terrain	Ice Beam	Ice	Special	90	100
Bridges	Air Slash	Flying	Special	75	95
With Misty Terrain in effect	Moonblast	Fairy	Special	95	100
With Electric Terrain in effect	Thunderbolt	Electric	Special	90	100
With Psychic Terrain in effect	Psychic	Psychic	Special	90	100

order-up.n:
If a Tatsugiri is on the player's bench, increase a stat 1 stage based on the Tatsugiri color (need a unique key for copies of Tatsugiri):
Curly Form (orange) raises Dondozo's Attack
Droopy Form (pink) raises Dondozo's Defense
Stretchy Form (yellow) raises Dondozo's Speed

triple-axel.n: Resets Power to baseline prior to cast after one cast.

triple-kick.n: Resets power to baseline prior to cast at the end of cast.

uproar.n: Prevents Sleep and wakes Sleeping Pokemon for all pokemon (enemy or player) within the screen.

doodle.n: Cannot gain additional projectiles. can only hit bosses. Change the ability of all pokemon the player has on their team to the hit target's Ability. This lasts until another effect changes it or the run ends.

double-shock.n: The pokemon loses the Electric type. If this would cause it to have no type, it is instead Normal type.

dragon-darts.n: Unique in that projectile damage is normalized for the base calculation and then doubled. so at base, each projectile deals the (Normalized damage x)

dream-eater.n: Only works on pokemon that are Asleep

eerie-spell.n: Increases the cooldown of other moves used in the last 2s by 3x their base cooldown.

chilly-reception.n: Select next highest priority pokemon. Set weather to Snowstorm.

chloroblast.n: Pokemon loses 1/2 it's Maximum HP per cast.

collision-course.n: If the move is type-advantaged, double the bonus from the type-advantage.

comeuppance.n: Uses 1.1x the last attack's power that hit this pokemon as the power for this move.

conversion.n: Randomly select a move pokemon has, change pokemon type to be that single type. This is just a type change for the run until cast again or other effect changes it.

court-change.n: Switch all Buffs and Debuffs on Player and enemies caught in burst radius.

entrainment.n: Can only be used on bosses. Cannot gain additional projectiles. Replaces the hit boss' Ability (not in game eyt) with the player's pokemon ability.

esper-wing.n: Crit rate is 3x pokemon's base crit. Raises Speed by 1 stage.

expanding-force.n: Power 1.5x on Psychic Terrain vs pokemon who do not have Fly.

facade.n:
Facade deals damage, and hits with double power (140) if the user is burned, poisoned or paralyzed.

In the case of a burn, the usual attack-halving still occurs so Facade hits with an effective power of 70.

final-gambit.n: No damage equation. Damage equals user's current HP at cast.

fire-pledge.n:
Fire Pledge deals damage at base power 80. If any other player uses Grass Pledge or Water Pledge in the last 2s,  Fire Pledge's power becomes 160.

If Grass Pledge has been cast by any other player's pokemon in the last 2s, Fire Pledge has 100% to inflict Burn.
If Water Pledge has been cast by any other player's pokemon in the last 2s, Fire Pledge doubles all status effect chances for all players for 8s. (Capped to 100%)

flame-burst.n: Splash damage is equal to 1/16 HP of the hit pokemon. Splash radius is 2x burst radius

bestow.n: Can only target other player's pokemon. Deals no damage. Target player gains this player's held item, prompts target player to keep or deny the given item.

bide.n: No other moves are used for 4s. (cooldowns keep moving). tracks damage taken for 4s, then Burst for 2x Damage taken as Normal type.

bleakwind-storm.n: Has 30% to lower target's Speed by one stage. If weather is rain, increase power 1.2x

after-you.n: Nearest Ally that is within 20x pokemon sprite radius has cooldown rate increased by 25% for 2s.

ancient-power.n: The 10% is rolled once and then all stats raise +1. not each stat rolls.

assist.n: Randomly selects and uses one of the player’s other Pokémon’s moves. This gains the cooldown of the used move.

baton-pass.n: Force swap to highest priority pokemon, buffs are removed from this pokemon and applied to the swapped in pokemon, keeping the time remaining.

beat-up.n: UsersBaseAttack ÷ 10 + 5, Hits up 6 times. reduced by 1 for each pokemon that is Fainted or has a debuff.

imprison.n: Does what it says, though really only useful in Gym Leader boss battles or Elite Four. Kind as Projectile that cannot gain additional projectiles.

infernal-parade.n: If enemy has an active debuff (burned, poisoned, confused, etc), power for this atack is 2x.

instruct.n: Can only be used on another player's pokemon. Does not target enemies. Prompts the target pokemon to learn the move cast before this one. Can not be this move. The target pokemon must have a slot available to learn the move.

ion-deluge.n: Normal type moves become electric for 2s

last-respects.n: This move's power and radius increases by +0.2x per fainted team pokemon. e.g. if 3 team pokemon are fainted, this move has 1.6x power and radius.

grass-pledge.n:
Grass Pledge deals damage at base power 80. If any other player uses Fire Pledge or Water Pledge in the last 2s,  Grass Pledge's power becomes 160.

If Fire Pledge has been cast by any other player's pokemon in the last 2s, Grass Pledge has 100% to inflict Burn.
If Water Pledge has been cast by any other player's pokemon in the last 2s, Grass Pledge halves hit pokemons speed for 8s.

water-pledge.n:
Water Pledge deals damage at base power 80. If any other player uses Grass Pledge or Fire Pledge in the last 2s, Water Pledge's power becomes 160.


If Grass Pledge has been cast by any other player's pokemon in the last 2s, Water Pledge halves hit pokemons speed for 8s.
If Fire Pledge has been cast by any other player's pokemon in the last 2s, Water Pledge doubles all status effect chances for all players for 8s. (Capped to 100%)

weather-ball.n: The damage type matches the weather effect type. Double power if there is weather.
